description: Connect pdfFiller to automate documents, e signatures workflows.

pdffiller_new_fillable_form_trigger.description: Runs when new fillable form appears after the initial complete scan. Polls at your plan interval; updates between polls may be combined. Watches at most 4,000 records.

pdffiller_new_signature_request_trigger.description: Runs when new signature request appears after the initial complete scan. Polls at your plan interval; updates between polls may be combined. Watches at most 4,000 records.

pdffiller_new_template_trigger.description: Runs when new template appears after the initial complete scan. Polls at your plan interval; updates between polls may be combined. Watches at most 4,000 records.
